headline: Expanse Rages as Berm and Shelf Reignite
war_summary: Since the 21:11 edition the wire has shifted to the Weathered Expanse, Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf while older fronts fall silent. The Expanse files thirteen changes in two hours to 00:11 for fifty-eight on the day, now four Warden, two Colonial and three unheld about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Shattered Advance, with twenty-four-hour losses of 7,828 Colonial and 11,634 Warden. Palantine Berm follows with ten changes in two hours to 23:55 for thirty on the day, now four Warden and three Colonial about The Droll, The Pippeli Stones and Leiri Hermanni, with losses of 681 and 693. Stlican Shelf adds five changes in two hours to 23:32 for twenty-seven on the day, now one Warden, seven Colonial and one unheld about Briar, Port of Rime and Breaker Town. Callahan's Passage, the Nevish Line, Stonecradle and Kuura Strand, busy through yesterday about Crumbling Post, Blinding Stones, The Reach and Martti, record no change in the last two hours.
